d:
nahin gae, iphtar men islamik topi pahante hain aur daliton ka apman karte hain. ye kuchh aise sandesh hain, jo uttar pradesh ke suchna evan jansanpark vibhag ke ek pramukh grup men sajha kie gae. is grup men vibhag ke varishth adhikariyon ke sath sarkar dvara niyukt char niji piaar ejensiyon ke sadasy bhi shamil hain.
Nyuzlondri ki partal men samne aaya hai ki sarkar ki kalyankari yojnaon aur vikas karyon ke prachar ke lie jimmedar suchna vibhag aur usse juri ejensiyan vipaksh ko hindu virodhi dikhane vali samagri par bhi kam kar rahi hain.
